title: Daily Devotional #43
paragraphs: As I read through Mark 15, I am struck by the brutality and suffering that Jesus endured in his final hours on Earth. The injustice and cruelty of his trial and execution are difficult to comprehend, but I am reminded that through his sacrifice, we have been given the gift of salvation.

In verse 3, Pilate asks Jesus if he is the King of the Jews, and Jesus simply responds, "You have said so." This humble and peaceful response in the face of false accusations and impending death is a testament to the strength of Jesus' faith and his trust in your plan for him.

As I read about the soldiers mocking and beating Jesus, I am filled with sorrow and anger. How could they treat him with such cruelty and disrespect? And yet, I know that my sins contributed to his suffering on the cross. It is through his sacrifice that I have been forgiven and saved.

The moment when Jesus cries out, "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?" is heartbreaking, but it also reminds me that Jesus experienced the full weight of our sin and separation from you. Through his suffering, he bridged the gap between us and you, and we can now approach you with confidence and hope.

As I reflect on Mark 15, I am humbled by the depth of your love for us. You gave your only son to suffer and die for our sins, so that we could have eternal life with you. Help me to never forget the sacrifice that was made on my behalf, and to live each day in grateful obedience to you.
